title: 第7章 绿茶男
slug: 全职法师全本免费-全职法师最新章节列表
content_zh:
“真是……唉，这个学生怎么就没分配到我班上，落到了张建国的手上，这下让张建国捡到天宝了。”班主任薛木生脸上写满了羡慕嫉妒。
而在最前面的穆白，脸上惊讶过后多了几分阴沉和不屑。
雷系了不起啊，如果不懂得修炼的话还是一个废柴，华国人口这么多出一些强系没什么好大惊小怪的，又不是天生双系这种天纵英才，哼哼，等以后看我不把你踩扁，居然敢跟我抢风头。
哦，差点忘了看莫凡这渣渣是什么系了，觉醒这么久，基本上失败了吧。
“哇，哇，是火系也！！”
“不得了啊，我们班又多了一个火系。”
“是谁说他会觉醒失败的啊，居然是火系，好让人羡慕啊。”
雷霆系惊现的风波慢慢平息下去后，大家终于发现了莫凡的觉醒系。
那个叫之前觉醒火炎系叫做周敏的女孩显得有些小惊讶，特意多看了一眼莫凡，发现他的觉醒石上确实出现了火苗，这个火苗感觉还比自己的旺盛一些。
“8班又出了一个火系啊。”
“虽然没有雷霆系那么稀有，但火系也很厉害啊！”
“火……火系……”薛木生满脸呆滞的看着眼前这名学生。
雷霆系的出现让薛木生差点忘了这个问题学生的存在，本以为这个学生会觉醒失败，没有想到他竟然觉醒成功了，更更没有想到的是他觉醒的是出类拔萃的火系！！
这……这也是捡到宝了啊！！
而且看这火炎旺盛程度，貌似天赋还比周敏高一些。
薛木生真没有想到自己觉得会扯班级后退的学生居然突然给自己长脸了！
“不错，不错，很不错，叫什么名字……哦，莫凡对吧！”薛木生高兴的眯起眼睛。
“恩。”莫凡点了点头。
莫凡本以为有人看到了自己雷霆系的觉醒，但是当他观望四周的时候，却意外的发现根本没有人注意到自己之前的雷霆系觉醒……
估计那会隔壁班的雷霆系出现确实太震撼了，亦或者自己觉醒的雷霆系力量太微弱。

一开始觉醒时的强弱这东西有影响，但并非决定性的，就算一开始觉醒的系比较微弱，也可以通过后天努力修炼慢慢弥补起来。
“火系学生，恩，恩，以后一定要好好努力，有什么不懂的尽管来问老师。”班主任薛木生拍了拍莫凡的肩膀，很是欣慰的说道。
莫凡内心还在狂喜之中。
不过他并没有太过得意忘形，换作一般少年估计恨不得马上把自己刚才觉醒的雷霆系展现出来，一个天生双系完爆那个雷霆系家伙。
莫凡没有那么做，天妒英才，更何况人呢？
莫凡知道穆氏那边有人对自己很大敌意，自己若是展现出天生双系，要么服从，要么被干掉，自己是拥有了绝世双系，可自己终究太弱小了，等自己更强大了再猖狂起来也不迟！！
莫凡回头看了一眼穆白和赵坤三的反应。
果然，这两个家伙脸都在抽搐了！
“这小子走了什么****运，觉醒成功不说，还觉醒了火系！”穆白看似道貌岸然，心里面却脏话连篇了。
“我了个草，这怎么可能，火系……”狗腿子赵坤三也看得傻了。
“哈哈，我就说莫凡哥一定不凡，火系，牛B，就是牛B，你赵坤三一个风系的算个球啊。”张候开心的跳了起来，看到狗腿子赵坤三那副模样顿时感觉出人一口恶气。
赵坤三满脸怒意，风系最初和火炎系比拼的话，肯定是风系吃亏的！
莫凡转过身，满脸潇洒笑容，沐浴着阳光顿时宛如脚下地毯铺开，两边少女尖叫，怎一个春风得意可以形容。
从穆白身边走过的时候，莫凡默默的朝着他竖起了中指，整个鄙视动作一气呵成，看上去跟打招呼一样那么没有违和感。
穆白感觉自己吃了对方一整套气急攻心的嘲讽技能，胸口闷得要炸了。
深呼吸一口气，穆白告诉自己要保持形象，一定要保持形象，自己不能跟这个小瘪三一般见识，自己是穆家半个少爷，这家伙只是杂役的儿子。
“这个废物觉醒成功了不说，竟然觉醒的是前期优势很大的火系，废物也有废物的狗运……还有，更他妈气人的是隔壁班出现了一个罕见雷系，自己这个祖传冰系的风头被他完全压过去了，妈了个蛋！”表面上跟个白马王子的穆白在心里却早已经脏话连篇。
莫凡回到了自己的位置上，同时也感受到周围同学们那截然不同的目光……
“火系也，以后这家伙尽量别惹。”
“什么别惹，要打好关系，我一个光系要想在学校混下去，就得靠火系的大哥撑腰了。”

“对了他叫什么名字，是叫莫凡吗？”
周围同学窃窃私语，却也传入到了莫凡耳中，莫凡一阵神清气爽，又特意看了一眼同样听见这番话的穆白，果然穆白嘴角一直在抽。
莫凡早知道穆白是个什么货色，成天到晚装绿茶，一看他脸上那假假的无所谓表情就知道他心里极其不好受。
绿茶男，老子觉醒一个火系你就气成这个德性，等知道你莫凡爷爷还有雷霆系……你不得切腹自尽？？

content_en:
"It's really... Alas, why was this student not assigned to my class and fell into the hands of Zhang Jianguo? Now Zhang Jianguo has picked up the Tianbao." Class teacher Xue Musheng's face was full of envy and jealousy.
Mu Bai, who was at the front, had a look of surprise and then became a bit gloomy and disdainful.
The thunder element is amazing. If you don't know how to practice, you will still be a loser. With such a large population in China, there is nothing to make a fuss about some strong elements. It's not like you are born with two elements. Hehe, wait until I don't crush you in the future, you actually dare to steal the limelight from me.
Oh, I almost forgot to look at what kind of scumbag Mo Fan is. He has been awakened for so long, so he has basically failed.
"Wow, wow, it's the fire element!!"
"That's great, we have another fire element in our class."
"Who said he would fail to awaken? He is actually a fire element, so enviable."
After the storm over the sudden appearance of the Thunder Element slowly subsided, everyone finally discovered Mo Fan's Awakening Element.
The girl named Zhou Min, who had previously awakened the fire element, seemed a little surprised. She took a closer look at Mo Fan and found that there was indeed a flame on his awakening stone. The flame felt stronger than her own.
"Class 8 has another fire element."
"Although it's not as rare as the Thunder type, the Fire type is also very powerful!"
"Fire... Fire element..." Xue Musheng looked at the student in front of him with a dull expression.
The appearance of the thunder element made Xue Musheng almost forget the existence of this problematic student. He thought that this student would fail to awaken, but he didn't expect that he would succeed in awakening, and what's more, he didn't expect that he would awaken the outstanding fire element! !
This...this is also a treasure! !
And looking at the intensity of the flames, it seems that his talent is higher than Zhou Min's.
Xue Musheng really didn't expect that the student who he thought would push back the class would suddenly make him look bad!
"Not bad, not bad, very good. What's your name... Oh, Mo Fan, right?" Xue Musheng narrowed his eyes happily.
"Yes." Mo Fan nodded.
Mo Fan thought that someone had seen his awakening of the thunder element, but when he looked around, he unexpectedly found that no one had noticed his previous awakening of the thunder element...
It is estimated that the appearance of the thunder type from the next class was really shocking, or maybe the power of the thunder type he awakened was too weak.
The strength at the beginning of awakening has an impact, but it is not decisive. Even if the awakening system is relatively weak at the beginning, it can be gradually made up for through hard work the day after tomorrow.
"Fire students, um, um, you must work hard in the future. If you don't understand anything, just ask the teacher." The head teacher, Xue Musheng, patted Mo Fan on the shoulder and said happily.
Mo Fan was still in ecstasy.
However, he did not get too carried away. An ordinary young man would probably be eager to show off the thunder element he had just awakened. A person born with dual elements would completely destroy that thunder element guy.
Mo Fan didn't do that. God is jealous of talents, let alone people.
Mo Fan knew that there were people in the Mu clan who were very hostile to him. If he showed his natural dual abilities, he would either obey or be killed. He had the peerless dual abilities, but he was too weak after all. It would not be too late to become arrogant when he became stronger! !
Mo Fan looked back at Mu Bai and Zhao Kunsan's reactions.
Sure enough, the faces of these two guys were twitching!
"What kind of bad luck did this kid have? Not only did he successfully awaken, he also awakened the fire element!" Mu Bai seemed to be sanctimonious, but in his heart he was swearing a lot.
"I'm confused, how is this possible, the fire element..." Zhao Kunsan, the loser, was also dumbfounded.
"Haha, I told you that Brother Mo Fan must be extraordinary. He is a fire element, awesome, and awesome. You, Zhao Kunsan, and the wind element are nothing." Zhang Hou jumped up happily, and when he saw the look of the bastard Zhao Kunsan, he immediately felt a bad breath.
Zhao Kunsan's face was filled with anger, if the wind system initially competes with the fire system, the wind system will definitely suffer!
Mo Fan turned around, with a chic smile on his face. Bathed in the sunshine, it was like a carpet under his feet. The girls on both sides screamed. How can one describe the joy of spring breeze.
When passing by Mu Bai, Mo Fan silently raised his middle finger towards him. The entire gesture of contempt was done in one go, and it seemed as seamless as greeting him.
Mu Bai felt that he had eaten a whole set of angry and heart-wrenching taunting skills from the opponent, and his chest was so tight that it was about to explode.
Taking a deep breath, Mu Bai told himself that he had to maintain his image. He must maintain his image. He couldn't be the same as this little brat. He was half a young master of the Mu family, and this guy was just the son of a handyman.
"Not to mention that this loser's awakening was successful, but he actually awakened the fire element, which has a great advantage in the early stage. Even losers have bad luck... What's even more damning is that a rare thunder element appeared in the next class. He completely overpowered my ancestral ice element. What a fucking mess!" Mu Bai, who looked like a prince charming on the surface, was already swearing in his heart.
Mo Fan returned to his seat, and at the same time felt the completely different eyes of the students around him...
"As for the fire element, try not to mess with this guy in the future."
"Don't mess with me. We need to build a good relationship. If I, a light-type person, want to survive in school, I have to rely on the support of my fire-type brother."
"By the way, what's his name? Is it Mo Fan?"
The students around him whispered, but they also reached Mo Fan's ears. Mo Fan felt refreshed and looked at Mu Bai who also heard these words. As expected, the corners of Mu Bai's mouth kept twitching.
Mo Fan already knew what kind of person Mu Bai was. He wore green tea all day and night. One look at the fake indifferent expression on his face and he knew that he felt extremely uncomfortable.
Green Tea Man, I awakened a fire element and you became so angry. When you find out that your grandpa Mo Fan also has a thunder element... you are not allowed to commit seppuku? ?
